name: LUSD
fix_description: In supply(), do not use router.getAmountsOut() as a price oracle. AMM spot prices are manipulable via flash loans. Use Chainlink or TWAP oracle to determine the token value for payout calculation.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit requires a multi-step chain: aggregating liquidity from several flash loans, manipulating a PancakeSwap BTCB-BSC-USD pool via flashswap, abusing the loan contract’s getAmountsOut-based valuation, then unwinding and repaying all legs. The bug pattern is understandable once identified, but writing the PoC needs protocol-specific DeFi knowledge around AMM price manipulation, flash loans, and the target’s mint/withdraw flow.
